case_study: Council commissions an independent electrical survey. The supplier sets its own roster and accepts responsibility for the report.
A temporary analyst works inside the council team. Council sets daily priorities, approves leave and supervises the worker.
A managed help desk supplies a contracted resolution outcome. Its vendor directs the team, replaces staff and bears rework cost.
A 2023 pilot supplied supervised workers, but the current agreement instead buys a vendor-directed engineering design report.
The description only says specialist support and gives no information about supervision or deliverables.
A vendor promises a monthly output target, but council assigns each worker's tasks and approves their leave.
